note: Per-round ledger of this target's review history. The commit/merge gate keys freshness on the sibling record (<key>.json) — a fresh review of the exact reviewed bytes — but --record now refuses to file a record unless this ledger's last round reviewed those same bytes, so a record can never be filed for content the ledger never saw. This file is the history the record itself cannot carry: what each round found, what was fixed, what was refuted by execution. Rounds are appended in order; a header key already present is never rewritten or dropped by a later append.

findings_refuted_or_deferred: DEFERRED (consensus, 4/4): TOCTOU in plan-runner commit() — validate and read the card, then prompt, then git add, with no re-verification that the staged bytes are the validated bytes. Fix: hash at validation and re-check the staged blob before committing.

DEFERRED (consensus, 4/4): isCommittablePath allows any path under .karta/roundtable/, so one binder's commit can sweep in another's review record. Fix: allow only the exact expected record path(s) and require they exist.

DEFERRED (consensus, 4/4): #clearDelivery runs git worktree remove --force with no cleanliness check and does not warn that Clear destroys uncommitted work; on a partial sweep destruction precedes the survivor check.

DEFERRED (2/4): the commit gate is bypassable because the model can run git commit itself; the verb is un-supplyable through karta_dispatch, but the skill's do-not-commit-by-hand is prose, not enforcement.

DEFERRED (1/4): commitBinder does not enforce slug freshness against .karta/binders/archive/ or surviving refs/karta/<slug>/ refs; validate_binder.py only warns, and the runner checks exit code alone.

DEFERRED (1/4, pre-existing): collisionBatch ignores serialize:true and shared_resources, so items the binder forbids running together are batched concurrently. Recorded as finding 11 in docs/backlog/pi-parity-gaps/FINDINGS.md.
DEFERRED (1/4): mapWithConcurrencyLimit uses Promise.all, which rejects at the first worker failure and leaves the rest running un-awaited after the lease is released. Fix: allSettled, then throw.
DEFERRED (1/4): plan-runner uses raw ctx.cwd instead of git rev-parse --show-toplevel, so a dispatch from a subdirectory mis-resolves the binder path.
REFUTED (1/4): that MAX_PARALLEL_BUILDS = 4 is arbitrary — three panelists judged it a documented policy constant and confirmed the pool preserves result order and dependency order.
